standard.name: MIGS (Minimum Information about a Genome Sequence)
standard.abstract: Metadata standard describing the minimum contextual metadata for genome sequence records. The materials list MIxS/MIGS combination checklists for many sample types and environments (e.g., agriculture, air, built environment, host-associated), indicating the standard applies to sequence data plus environmental and host metadata captured as structured fields.

classification.rationale: The source lists many MIxS/MIGS combination checklists (e.g., "MigsBaAgriculture", "MigsEuAgriculture", "MigsOrgAgriculture") each described as "MIxS Data that comply with the ... checklist and the ... Extension", indicating a tabular set of metadata fields (checklists).
